definition.simple: Crops that are planted during the rainy season because they love a lot of water.
definition.academic: The crops which are sown in the rainy season (generally from June to September in India) are called kharif crops.

common_misconceptions: People think Kharif crops can grow in winter if given enough water. In reality, they also need specific temperature and humidity conditions of the monsoon.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: 'Since rice needs to stand in water, would you grow it in summer, winter, or monsoon?'
